notes: No article morpheme stands in פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד, so both the's are supplied under rule 29.

turtle doves is headed on turtle, since the ASV's ordinary rendering of תֹּר is the compound and it writes no bare doves in this verse, where יוֹנָה is rendered pigeons; heading on doves as a class noun was the competing reading.
